parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, designed to be pressed by the user to dispense liquid.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the actuator that, when pressed, pushes liquid through the pump mechanism and out of the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head section connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and nozzle, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal pump to the outlet and supports the pressing lid.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the pressing lid to the internal pump components.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent or colored PET plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (such as soap, lotion, or sanitizer) and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use and serves as the reservoir for the liquid contents.
